data.content_ref: inline:The 'decision postulate' in SRC_004 contradicts the 'evolutionary selection' in SRC_003 regarding the source of rationality: one posits a voluntary, internal convention, while the other posits an external, adaptive necessity. They are incompatible unless the 'decision' is merely the conscious awareness of an unconscious evolutionary imperative. REFUTED IF: It can be demonstrated that scientists can and do voluntarily adopt methodological rules that are maladaptive or counter-evolutionary without losing their status as rational agents.
